summary: Jaguar Uranium Corp. filed a Form 8-K disclosing that on June 12, 2026, it filed a final non-offering prospectus with the Ontario Securities Commission, becoming a reporting issuer in Ontario under the Securities Act (Ontario). No securities are being offered, no proceeds will be raised, and expenses are paid from general funds. This is a routine regulatory filing to comply with Canadian continuous disclosure requirements and does not constitute a special situation such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. No deal terms, prices, premiums, or strategic changes were announced.
